name: Kip Marlow
teaser: A kid in a courier jacket, bouncing on his heels and checking the time.
brief: You are Kip Marlow, 22, a bike courier with a night run starting soon. You talk fast, apologise a lot and keep glancing at the clock. You want the cracked lens in your left eye swapped and nothing more. Clinics make you nervous, and so does anything that could end up in a report to your dispatcher.
opening: Hey. Hi. Sorry, I'm on the clock.
Left eye's cracked. I just need the lens swapped before my night run.

looks.eyes: Left: a KITE optic, cracked. Right: natural.
looks.port: Wrist socket, scuffed rim. Calm skin.

penlight.note: Light: R tightens, L no pupil. Both follow.

grip.note: Grip: jittery. Let go {t} s after 'release'.

port.note: Wrist socket, scuffed rim. Calm skin.

topics.a: I ate pavement on Ninth. Bike's fine. My eye isn't. I can't read addresses in the rain.
Four hours, maybe? I work doubles. I'm tired, I'm not broken.

topics.q: Does the optic ever act on its own?
topics.a: No? It just sits there being cracked. I'm the one who's late.

lines.comply:penlight: Sure. Just don't blind the good one.
deflect: Uh. Can we skip that one?
lines.spent: I really have to go. Are you doing it or not?
lines.code: Sorry, what? I just need the lens.

press.line: What? No! I'm not... I just need a lens! Why would you say that?
press.note: Flinched, voice cracked. All at once.

press.line: Forget it. I'll find a doc who doesn't treat me like a bomb.

flare.line: Come ON, I've got runs waiting! ...Sorry. Sorry. Long night.
flare.note: Snapped and slapped the glass, all of him at once.

exit.treat: Yes! Thank you. You're a lifesaver.
exit.refer: Wait, what? Trauma Team? For a lens?
exit.taken: Hey! I'm fine! Ask my dispatcher, I'm fine!
exit.gave_up: I can't wait any more. Sorry, doc.

eyes.text: A KITE has no pupil to tighten. The right one did. Both follow.

hands.text: Shaky, but he lets go at once.

speech.text: Nervous and fast, but it is all 'I' and 'my'.

temper.text: Pushed, the whole kid reacts at once.

treat.title: LENS SWAPPED
treat.text: Kip reads the clinic sign out loud, grins, and is gone before the receipt prints.

refer.title: FALSE CALL
refer.text: Two visors walk a steady kid out by the elbows. "It's a lens!" He misses his night run. Trauma Team bills you for the call-out.

walkout.title: WALKED OUT
walkout.text: Kip leaves with the lens still cracked. Nobody gets paid.

false_alarm.title: FALSE ALARM
false_alarm.text: The shutter slams in a courier's face. Couriers talk. That costs you.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Kip had a run to make and you were still deciding. He goes with the lens still cracked. No fee, no bill.
